item.title: What is a nor’easter and a bomb cyclone? How major East Coast winter storms form
item.description: Forecasters are tracking a potential winter storm this weekend. Learn what a nor’easter and bomb cyclone are, and why these storms can bring heavy snow, strong winds and coastal flooding.

item.title: How does snow melt when temperatures are still below freezing?
item.description: Under certain conditions, snow and ice can melt even when the air temperature is below freezing. Learn the science behind it and how it affects winter weather.

item.title: Gas leak reported hours before deadly Bristol nursing home explosion, NTSB says
item.description: Federal investigators say a natural gas odor was reported hours before a deadly explosion at a Bristol nursing home. The NTSB investigation is ongoing.

item.title: Methacton High cheer team stranded in Texas by winter storm returns to Philadelphia
